question: Four letter-clusters have been given out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
solution:
The position of the English alphabet letters is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

**Logic: Addition of +3 in the first letter and +4 in the second letter.**

**Option 1) **MPT

⇒ M(13) + 3 → P(16) + 4 → T(20)

**Option 2) **FIM

⇒ F(6) + 3 → I(9) + 4 → M(13)

**Option 3) **GJN

⇒ G(7) + 3 → J(10) + 4 → N(14

**Option 4) **DGI

⇒ D(4) + 3 →** G(7) + 2 **→ I(9)

According to the logic, DGI is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is **"DGI".**
